operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 101. There is hereby established the President's Commission on the Status of Women, referred to herein as the "Commission". The Commission shall terminate not later than October 1, 1963.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 101

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 102. The Commission shall be composed of twenty members appointed by the President from among persons with a competency in the area of public affairs and women's activities. In addition, the Secretary of Labor, the Attorney General, the Secretary of Health, Education and-Welfare, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Agriculture and the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission shall also serve as members of the Commission. The President shall designate from among the membership a Chairman, a Vice-Chairman, and an Executive Vice-Chairman.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 102

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 103. In conformity with the Act of May 3, 1945 (59 Stat. 134, 31 U.S.C. 691), necessary facilitating assistance, including the provision of suitable office space by the Department of Labor, shall be furnished the Commission by the Federal agencies whose chief officials are members thereof. An Executive Secretary shall be detailed by the Secretary of Labor to serve the Commission.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 103

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 104. The Commission shall meet at the call of the Chairman.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 104

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 105. The Commission is authorized to use the services of consultants and experts as may be found necessary and as may be otherwise authorized by law.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); Sec. 105
